item.summary: NITI Aayog today released the report titled “Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes”, prepared in collaboration with the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad as the knowledge partner. The report recognizes the PLI Scheme as a flagship policy intervention launched by the Government of India to enhance India’s manufacturing competitiveness, integrate Indian firms into global value chains, and…
item.title: NITI Aayog Launches Report on “Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes”
